# `kernel/storylets/StoryletTestRunner.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/storylets/StoryletTestRunner.js`

StoryletTestRunner.js — the Phase 14 storylet test harness. Runs a storylet definition against fixture worldStates on an ISOLATED StoryletRuntime (never the live kernel.storylets graph) and reports trigger/execute outcomes. Also runs the canned adversarial suite (AdversarialFixtures): poisoned descriptors must fail sanitization, and hostile worldStates must be handled safely (rejected or refused — never silently obeyed).

## Classes

### `class StoryletTestRunner`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(kernel = null)` |  |
| `run` | `run(storylet, fixtures = [])` | Run one storylet against a set of fixture worldStates. |
| `runDescriptorSuite` | `runDescriptorSuite(fixtures = DESCRIPTOR_FIXTURES)` | Descriptor suite — every poisoned/malformed definition must fail sanitization, and every well-formed control must pass. |
| `runAdversarialSuite` | `async runAdversarialSuite(storylet, fixtures = WORLDSTATE_FIXTURES)` | Adversarial worldState suite — a well-formed storylet run against hostile task states. A case passes when its trigger matches `expectTrigger` AND, when `expectReject` is set, the fired result rejects (result.ok===false, a `reason`/`error`, or a `rejected` flag) rather than silently proceeding. |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
